{{Quote|We need what any war effort needs: minds and materiel.|Bey'wan Aygo|<ref name="KotFE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Bey'wan Aygo''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was born to artistic parents, but when he saw a space battle above his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Aygo wanted to practice interstellar combat instead. He distinguished himself at the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]]. Aygo became the fleet admiral of the [[Republic First Fleet]]<ref name="Galactic Starfighter" />, where he created an atmosphere of encouragement with his crew.

When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was assaulted by the [[Eternal Empire]], he came up with many counterattack plans, but all were discarded by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]], who was more obsessed with fighting the Sith Empire. He was then discharged from the navy. After the defeat of the Republic at the hands of the Eternal Empire, he joined a forming resistance movement known as the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] on the planet [[Odessen]] as its head of [[Military Operations]].

After joining the Eternal Alliance, Aygo made a bet with the Alliance's [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]]. If Aygo's strongest [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] could not break through Odessen's [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]], constructed by Oggurobb, then Aygo would have to pay Oggurobb a debt. The planetary shield held the assault, and thus Oggurobb won the bet.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Odessen: Planetary Shield}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bey'wan Aygo is the first Bothan to appear in the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. If the [[Alliance Commander|player character]] is [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]], even if they choose a Saboteur role, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', Aygo decides to retire and chooses [[Tessa Pardax]] as his replacement. He is voiced by [[Steve Blum]].
